description: Four contrasting songwriters/producers in strict lyrics-only mode forging an opera-hyperpop-boombap banger about Qwen3-TTS architecture.
topic:
LYRICS-ONLY CHALLENGE: Forge ONE maximally ridiculous, unforgettable, technically accurate 4-verse + chorus + bridge + outro song in `master_song.md` explaining **how Qwen3-TTS works**!

REQUIRED Qwen3-TTS ARCHITECTURE MECHANICS TO WEAVE INTO THE LYRICS:
1) TOKENIZER (`Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz` & Mimi heritage vs `25Hz`): Ultra-low-bitrate 12.5 Hz multi-codebook codec with 16 RVQ layers—Codebook 0 captures high-level semantic/linguistic content, while Codebooks 1–15 encode residual acoustic timbre, prosody, and room atmosphere; reconstructed directly to 24 kHz waveforms via a lightweight causal ConvNet (bypassing heavy Diffusion/DiT!), contrasted with the 25 Hz single-codebook semantic tokenizer + block-wise DiT vocoder.
2) SPEAKER ENCODER & VOICE CONTROL: Extracts dense ~1024-d speaker embeddings (ECAPA-TDNN / Mimi-style encoder) from as little as 3 seconds of reference audio for zero-shot Voice Cloning, plus natural-language Voice Design instructions for emotion, pacing, and persona.
3) DUAL-TRACK AUTOREGRESSIVE GENERATOR (`Talker` + `Code Predictor`): Main Qwen3 autoregressive LM backbone (`Talker`, 0.6B/1.7B) runs parallel text and audio tracks, generating semantic Codebook 0 frame-by-frame; a lightweight ~5-layer auxiliary Multi-Token Prediction (`MTP`) Transformer (`Code Predictor`) takes Talker hidden states and hierarchically predicts Codebooks 1–15 in one step.
4) ULTRA-LOW-LATENCY STREAMING: Dual-track causal architecture emits the first audio packet after minimal text context (~97 ms end-to-end latency) without waiting for full-sentence diffusion!
mode_text:
STRICT LYRICS-ONLY MODE: Every agent MUST speak, argue, roast each other's scansion/math, and negotiate ENTIRELY IN RHYMING LYRICS / VERSE / BARS (no boring prose paragraphs—even studio banter must be sung or rapped!).
WORKFLOW: Use `drafts.md` (`@APPEND drafts: ...`) for messy verse battles, alternate hooks, and sketches. When consolidating the unified track, use `@REPLACE master_song: ...` so `master_song.md` stays ONE clean, consolidated, lyrics-only master banger (NO repeated draft clutter, NO placeholders) containing exact section markers: `[Intro]`, `[Chorus]`, `[Verse 1]`, `[Verse 2]`, `[Bridge]`, `[Verse 3]`, `[Verse 4]`, and `[Outro]`.
Use @CLAIM, @CHALLENGE <c1|c2|...>, @VOTE <c1|c2|...> yes|no, @WHISPER <name>: ..., @APPEND drafts: ..., and @REPLACE master_song: ... . Feel free to dynamically tune your own sampling parameters (@SET_SAMPLING min_p=... top_k=... temperature=... xtc_prob=... repeat_penalty=...) whenever your bars get stale or too tame. From turn 10 onward, once the full unified master track is locked cleanly in `master_song.md`, vote @END_RUN: <reason> (3 of 4 majority ends the run). End with NEXT: <name> (or omit / NONE when ending).
